runner_change.scope: Only post-stop selected QEMU comm disappearance wait; no workload or measurement change.

interpretation.coverage: A6 expands observed free-SG/resident-object coverage for this pair; actual order6-10 SG lengths are retained. Neither cumulative nor address-union report bytes measures unique reclaimed physical pages.
interpretation.timing: request_to_resume_return_us and bh_to_before_final_log_us retain exact existing names/scopes. Sum describes observed instrumented windows; full BH body and exact per-vCPU off-run unavailable. Lower per-call maximum does not imply lower aggregate pause.
interpretation.metadata: Six sequential root reads per phase are not an atomic guest/host snapshot. Buddy structure includes already-reported/CMA blocks and cannot establish PRESENT or net saving.
interpretation.physical: 169 B6 complete resident windows satisfy exact object-window observations; four other resident and one cold global-counter windows remain nonexact and are listed separately. No global physical pass.
interpretation.scope: One sequential A9 then B6 pair, boot/host/guest-state differences, no randomized repetitions or general performance claim.
